text: For tenant paper-kite and risk lantern-watch only, on a USD settlement event, match when that merchant's total settled value in the immediately preceding completed UTC calendar day is strictly greater than 12.50 USD. Count each settlement once; do not count authorizations or the current incomplete day. Values supplied to the rule are integer USD cents. This is a representation of the existing policy, with no tuning latitude.

fields.name: sum_lumen_completed
fields.meaning: Merchant total of unique settlements in the previous completed UTC calendar day; excludes authorizations and the current day

fields.name: sum_lumen_current
fields.meaning: Merchant settlement total so far in the current incomplete UTC day; supplied only to distinguish windows
